# Toya's Touch Hair Studio

> Natural hair, braids & color based in Round Rock, Texas. Silk presses, two-strand twists, braids, wigs, sew-ins and color from Toya's private suite inside The Courtyard Salons in Round Rock. Beauty is only a touch away.

- Phone: (832) 305-7366

- Google rating: 5.0 from 28 reviews

## Services
- Silk press & smoothing: Swingy, bone-straight presses with movement, and the Texture Release smoothing treatment when you want it to last.
- Twists, coils & retwists: Two-strand twists, coils and flat rope twist updos on natural hair, plus root retwists for locs.
- Braids & crochet: Clean cornrows, feed-ins and box braids, kids' braids, and crochet styles that hold up for weeks.
- Wigs, weaves & sew-ins: Quick weaves, sew-ins, lace closure and frontal installs, and wig drop-off care.
- Color & relaxers: All-over color, highlights, high-lift reds and blondes, ombré tips, relaxers and curl reformation.
- Cuts, updos & treatments: Big chops, cut and style, wedding and event updos, plus Olaplex, protein and scalp treatments.

## About
Toya has been a licensed cosmetologist since 2002. Toya's Touch Hair Studio is her own suite, B-19, inside The Courtyard Salons on the I-35 frontage road in Round Rock, so every appointment is one-on-one with Toya. She works with every hair type: natural, relaxed, damaged and matted. Silk presses and twists, braids and crochet, wigs, sew-ins and extensions, color and relaxers. Clients drive in from Austin, Pflugerville, Georgetown, Hutto, Leander and Cedar Park, and some have been with her for eight years. What clients mention most: gentle hands, even on tender-headed kids, honest advice about healthy hair, fresh ideas for the next style, and conversation so good the time flies.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I book with Toya?
  A: Book online through her booking page, which shows every open time, or text (832) 305-7366. Books open 4 to 5 weeks out, and new openings are posted on Facebook and Instagram.
- Q: Where is the studio?
  A: Inside The Courtyard Salons at 2000 S I-35 Frontage Rd, Building F1, Suite B-19, Round Rock, TX 78681. Come in the front doors and head to Suite B-19.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Tuesday to Thursday 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Friday 9:30 AM to 6 PM and Saturday 8 AM to 2:30 PM. Closed Sunday and Monday.
- Q: Do you do kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Parents bring in daughters and sons for braids, natural styles and loc upkeep, and reviews mention how patient Toya is with tender heads. Kids can be dropped off, or a parent can wait in the courtyard.
- Q: Is shampoo included?
  A: Only where the service says so. Shampoo can be added to any service, and detangling, comb-outs and take-downs are extra. All prices are starting prices.
- Q: I want color. Where do I start?
  A: New color clients start with a consultation, by video for $25 or in the shop for $30, so Toya can plan the right color for your hair.
